items.title: Mailbox status says what actually works
items.detail: Replaced the saved 'Not connected' flag with one rule (src/mailStatus.ts): Working, Receiving only, No mail arriving yet, Not set up, Sign in needed.

items.title: All mail view
items.detail: Every account and tab in one list, no grouping.

items.title: Sorting rules editor
items.detail: Taught senders and own rules for Primary, Promotions, Social, Updates, Forums.

items.title: Shared inbox levels and groups
items.detail: Read, Reply, Manage per person or group; private inboxes hidden from admins.

items.title: Backup sign-in email
items.detail: So losing a company mailbox never locks you out of your other workspaces.

items.title: Brands inside a workspace
items.detail: Name, logo, colour, signature and sending domain per brand.

items.title: Domain step: connect or buy
items.detail: Sign up with any email, then connect your domain or buy one.

items.title: One interface for guests and team
items.detail: Workspace switcher lists the workspaces you're a guest in.
